answer: The chain re-audits one past answer per agent against a fresh nonce: the verifier reseeds the transcript inputs and demands the same conclusion within 90 seconds, so one honest agent with its own 16 GB working set recomputes cleanly while ten fakes sharing one model must serialize ten recomputations and breach the deadline. Ten parallel 24 GB GPU slots cost $4.80 per hour against $0.48 for one node. Divergence slashes the bond and freezes the delta seat, and the audit log is public so timber peers can check the nonce was random, with violet as anchor.
